About Me

Hello, I'm Rahul!

I'm a Masters student at Georgia Tech passionate about the intersection of Robotics, Computer Vision, and Machine Learning. When I'm not diving deep into algorithms and robotic systems, you'll find me exploring the world through various hobbies and interests.

My Hobbies

I'm someone who believes in living life to the fullest. I like teaching me something new about the world and myself.

Music & Guitar

I love playing guitar and exploring different musical genres. Music is my way of unwinding and expressing creativity beyond the technical world.

Stargazing

There's something magical about looking up at the night sky. Stargazing reminds me of the vastness of the universe and fuels my curiosity about exploration.

Adventure

Whether it's hiking, exploring new places, or trying new experiences, I love stepping out of my comfort zone and discovering what the world has to offer.
